CollaborationNote.title: CollaborationNote
CollaborationNote.description: A public Web3 collaboration note posted by portfolio visitors on the Papan Catatan Kolaborasi, with automatic 1-month (30-day) expiration.

senderName.description: Name or alias of the visitor leaving the note (1-60 chars).

senderHandle.description: Contact handle (X, Telegram, or Email) of the visitor (1-80 chars).

topic.description: Collaboration topic selected by the visitor.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the note was created.

createdAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds when the note was created.

expiresAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds when the note expires (1 month / 30 days after creation).

authorToken.description: Client token allowing the original author to delete their note.

/collaboration_notes/{noteId}.description: Public collaboration notes stored in Firestore that automatically expire and get deleted 1 month (30 days) after creation.
